description: Read-only renderer for one database field value (DB-2). It sits on top of NotionDatabaseValueFormatter and adds the presentation the plain text lost: a colored pill for Select/Status/MultiSelect, initials for a person, a check for a checkbox and nothing for an empty value.

parameters.name: DateFormat
parameters.description: Date format passed to the shared formatter. Defaults to a short date.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: The field the value belongs to. Drives the presentation.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The raw stored value. Null or empty renders nothing.
